title: 🆕 New Pair: 7znWX3RVEQJtxki6VsMP... on solana
summary:
PumpCall is a live KOL callout arena. Every callout renders as a fighting tile whose coin image floods green as it pumps and bleeds red as it dumps, driven by real-time market cap. Callers become gamified fighter cards with rank, streak, accuracy and XP, so a call is attached to a track record instead of disappearing into a feed.

TELEGRAM-BOT
Every new callout posts to the channel as a single image - the coin's picture plus the ticker, market cap at call time, and the caller. Posts are tagged by type: a plain live callout, a holder-posted call, or a conviction call backed by a $PUMPCALL burn. Deep links go straight to the coin's page with PUMP/DUMP buttons, so you can predict from the message.

Auto-trader activity. Every real trade posts as it happens:

🟢 BOUGHT — ticker, size in SOL, entry market cap
🟢/🔴 SOLD — realised PnL in SOL and percent, coloured by outcome
⏭️ SKIPPED — coins it evaluated and passed on

Each carries the coin's audit snapshot: top-10 holder concentration, launch-bundle percentage, holder count, insider share, and the RugCheck verdict. So the channel is a running, timestamped record of what the bot bought, what it refused, and what it made or lost.

AUTO-TRADER
A companion trading bot acts on callouts automatically, and it runs in the open. It holds its own wallet,  the arena never touches a trading key  and takes positions with configurable entry gates and exits: take-profit, stop-loss and a hold timeout, sized per trade. Entry screening covers holder count, launch-bundle and top-holder concentration, rug checks, coin and call freshness, and one trade per X post so a relaunch of the same story cannot be bought twice.

Everything it does is public and verifiable. A live dashboard shows open positions, every buy and sell, the skip reason for each coin it passed on, and a running P&L read from the wallet's on-chain transactions - network fees and slippage included - rather than from the bot's own report. It can be handed a contract address over an API, and it can be stopped instantly.

PREDICTIONS
Anyone can make free PUMP/DUMP predictions. They are wallet-bound, server-settled and build only a non-cashable reputation score - a skill game, not gambling.

$PUMPCALL
A creator and visibility utility token. Holding it unlocks call posting by tier (Micro 10k / Alpha 50k / Whale 250k), XP multipliers and priority feed placement. Burning it buys visibility: a feed-pin auction for the top slot, and conviction burns that put an irreversible stake behind a call - every burn verified on-chain and published in a public ledger.
